page.layout: Two parallel columns at the top: left a Hebrew column, right a Latin column in italic commentary type. Below them a centred heading "ANNOTATIONES.", then one full-width column of running text. No marginal notes. Printed page number at the head left, running head at the head centre, catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: totum damnum prastatur ; pro innocenti sive mansueto prastatur damni dimidium. Si eum dominus vinculo vinxerit & debitè conclu-serit, egressus tamen damnum intulerit ; sive innocens, sive convi-ctus sit,³ prastanda culpa. uti sentit D. Meir. Doctor Iudas inquit, Innocens sive mansuetus tenetur ; ⁴ convictus verò liber est:quia (Ex. 21. 36.) dicitur⁵. Et non asserva-verit eum dominus ejus: atqui hic asservatus fuerat. Doctor Eliezer inquit, Non aliter asser-vatur⁶, quam cultro.
main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES.
main_text.p: {1} Quatuor isti hominum ordines, qui bovem à proprie-tario acceperunt, diversi sunt. Nam primus ac secundus à duobus reliquis differunt, quod nulla merces in illis intercedat; quemadmodum in his: primus à secundo, quod ille gratis operam suam impendat; hic gratis commodum percipiat:tertium denique à quarto distinguit diversa mercedis assignatio, hic enim mercede dat;ille accipit. {2} Hæc sequentia verba, Si egressus damnum dederit, non habentur in omnibus codicibus; sed quamvis in quibusdam desiderentur,satis è sequentibus liquet,subaudiri: siquidem nullum damnum, nisi datum fit, præstari debeat. Cæterum hanc Misnæ partem non absolutè ab omnibus admitti, ex ultima præcedetis Misnæ Gemara constat.{3} Cum vero præstanda culpa dicitur, cave (si verba Meïri ex vulgari sententia accipias) hic exigas æqualitatem:nam iis convenienter quæ hic præcedunt & in superioribus explicata sunt,pro bovis conditione diversa,dimidium vel totum damnum præstari volunt. Atq; ne verbis Mosaïcæ

page.notes: Hebrew column of the parallel block printed in right-to-left order, left column. Italic Latin commentary on the right of the top block. Superscript reference marks in the Latin text are given as {1}–{6} or as plain superscript digits where the printed mark is a superscript numeral; the notes for them are not printed as separate notes on this page. The Hebrew line 9 is shortened in print and is copied as seen. Final line of the page is a catchword, not part of the text.
